name: Greenthumb
description: Crop tracker for your farms. Set up farms and areas (Outside, Greenhouse, Inside), press Planted, Watered and Harvested at your planters, and Greenthumb does the timing: a countdown on every planter, and a chat line plus an on-screen notice when a watering window opens, an hour before it closes, and when the crop is ready. Go to farm points the compass at it. Open it with the plant icon, /greenthumb or its key in the Add-Ons window.
author: Kronic
